chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Allah, Mighty and Majestic, no one can estimate His worth; and likewise, no one can estimate the worth of His Prophet; and likewise, no one can estimate the worth of the believer. When he meets his brother and shakes his hand, Allah looks at both of them, and the sins fall from their faces until they part, just as the strong wind causes the leaves to fall from the tree.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of shaking hands between believers in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to highlight the metaphysical weight of social bonds in Shia spirituality, equating the believer's status with that of Allah and His Prophet. The imagery of sins falling like leaves underscores the concept of *tawassul* through righteous interaction, where mutual recognition serves as a divine mechanism for spiritual purification and mercy.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, no one can estimate Hisazwj Self; and like that, no one can estimate the Self of Hisazwj Prophetsaww; and like that no one can estimate the worth of the Momin. He (the Momin) meets his brother and shakes his hand, so Allahazwj looks at both of them, the sins fall off from their faces until they separate, just as the intense wind causes the leaves to fall off from the tree’.
en.sarwar: 20. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Bakr ibn Muhammad from Ishaq ibn ‘ Ammar who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘No one is able to describe Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, as He should be described. In the same way His Holy Prophet cannot be described. Also, the importance of the believing people cannot be described. When he meets his brother (in belief) and shakes hands, Allah looks toward them and sins began to fall from their faces like strong wind blows away leaves from trees, until they depart each other.’”
